hypothesis.statement: The 26 remaining differing words are ONE consistent recolor whose only uncontrolled positions are two NON-SOURCE webs, each with exactly one defining instruction in each stream. (1) The loop-invariant JUMPTABLE BASE temp, defined once per stream and quoted from `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/game/gamemain init_next_level_8005638C 0xf8:0x104 --diff`: target `@0x00fc addi r23,r3,0 @jumptable_8011C754(ADDR16_LO)` against ours `@0x00fc addi r27,r3,0 @@2408(ADDR16_LO)`; its only consumer is target `@0x0134 lwzx r0,r23,r0` / ours `@0x0134 lwzx r0,r27,r0`. (2) The PARAMETER HOME, likewise a single definition, from `... 0x0:0x14 --diff`: target `@0x0010 mr. r25,r3` against ours `@0x0010 mr. r28,r3`. Declaration order governs every source-declared local -- probes 5 and 6 below established that, and it is what moved `w` and `id` onto the target's r22 and r21 -- but no declaration can name a hoisted compiler temp, and probe 6 showed declaring a local for the parameter makes things worse. The untried axis is the `#pragma opt_common_subs off` bracketing this function (gamemain.c line 5022, pre-existing, authored by an earlier lane): it changes which webs exist at allocation time, so removing or re-scoping it is the one remaining source-level control over where those two definitions land.
